# ASLWF — single paper-aligned reproducibility protocol

**Paper:** 45-page manuscript dated 2026-10-17, "Introduction - 副本(20261017-032905).pdf".
**Submission branch:** paper-aslwf-repro-20261017.
**Only accepted observation protocol:** full-update signed feature hash **2,048 dimensions**, with **exactly eight milestone rounds** \`1, 10, 30, 50, 75, 100, 125, 150\`.
**No legacy run mode, no alternative hash dimension, no 10-round capture or attack.** All source-level paper jobs must be generated by \`src.acm_revision.paper_protocol_plan\`.

## What is and is not reproduced

This code reconstructs the manuscript's *method* and one canonical experiment/attack protocol. It has not yet independently verified all published numerical tables. Original seed-specific locked basis files, raw/preprocessed dataset, FL outputs and attack archives are essential to a numerical reproduction. Different acquisition or attack protocols can produce **different results** from historical runs; never paste previously reported AUROCs into new outputs or claim that old numbers were generated by this code without matched provenance.

Old generated YAML files and historical logs were removed **from this submission branch only**. Original experiments remain in the two earlier Git branches. The submission branch contains one official protocol, not selectable historical variants.

## Exact paper specification

| Dimension | Exact specification |
| --- | --- |
| Dataset/task | Hateful Memes, binary classification, use official task validation for checkpoint selection and task test only for reporting |
| Architecture | CLIP ViT-L/14, both encoders trainable; 512-d projected representations, dropout 0.5; concatenation + elementwise product + absolute difference fusion; learned missing-modality embeddings |
| Modality regimes | image-only, text-only, modality-exclusive (persistent single modality per client) |
| Label concentrations | c=0.5/0.7/0.9; c=0.5 is a nominal-role attribution control, *not* a true majority label |
| Client composition | 12 clients/run, 6 image + 6 text in modality-exclusive; 3 clients for each label role per modality |
| Pools | duplicate-aware strictly disjoint shadow-train/shadow-val/target (40%/20%/40%); no within-run sample reuse |
| Samples per client | shadow-train 200, shadow-val 100, target 200 |
| Core training | 3 regimes x 3 concentrations x (2 shadow-train + 1 shadow-val + 5 target) = 72 independent FL runs |
| Seeds | shadow-train 142/143, shadow-val 242, target 42–46 |
| Federated hyperparameters | 150 rounds, 100% client participation, 1 local epoch, AdamW LR=1e-6, weight decay .05, batch size 16; FedAvg |
| Core attack/capture milestones | **1,10,30,50,75,100,125,150** |
| CPT training | shadow-train rounds 1,10,30,50 |
| CPT selection | shadow-val rounds 75,100,125,150 |
| CPT target | 100,125,150 |
| CP | disjoint shadow-training, validation, target populations/trajectories, no enforced stage separation |
| Observation surfaces | 9: classifier_head; bias; weight; fusion; image; text; missing_modality; all_shared; full_update |
| Representation | head, bias, weight, fusion, missing exact; image/text/all_shared fixed 16,384 coordinate sketches; full_update **2,048 signed hash contributions from every floating update coordinate** |
| Basis estimation | 96 identical-checkpoint concentrated-vs-balanced (70/30 vs 50/50) local contrasts from shadow-only seed142, 8 checkpoints x 12 client roles, 100 samples per matched branch, sample overlap maximized; centered SVD |
| Large parameter group basis | rank <=5, 512-dimensional orthonormal-row signed hash projection, seed 20260820; distinct from 2048-d *attack* full-update hash |
| Matched subspace weak/strong | (r,alpha)=(1,.25), (5,1) selected from shadow-val seed242 |
| Per-client filtering budget | After each eligible filtered local update, enforce relative L2 perturbation <=1 on the exact classifier-head coordinates and <=1 on the original full-update coordinates. Scale the filtering difference uniformly if either limit is exceeded. Does not replace Clip+Gaussian clipping. |
| Complete ASLWF | attacker-guided classifier-head basis learned with shadow_train 142/143 at rounds <=60 and chosen on independent shadow-val 242 at rounds >=61; alpha_head=1; replaces matched classifier-head basis; other four groups retain strong matched bases |
| Attack models and selection | LR/RF/MLP x 9 surfaces x CP/CPT = 54; model+surface+protocol+orientation chosen using shadow-val **only**, target five AUROCs averaged separately |
| Common-shadow audit | **shadow_train seed142** for fitting each method's defense-aware attackers (No Defense / Matched-contrast Only / Complete ASLWF); each uses shadow-val 242 and target 42–46. Seed143 may still be used to *construct* Complete ASLWF's head basis but does not enter common-shadow attack fitting |
| Analysis | classifier-head per-round 12 x 1026 uncentered SVD, cosine gap and effective rank; centered matched contrasts separately; fixed-round and pooled milestones not conflated |
| Utility | checkpoint chosen using validation AUROC; target test AUROC at that checkpoint; paired run-level comparisons |
| Threat model | honest-but-curious server sees individual updates (no secure aggregation), defense-aware attackers; no formal DP guarantee |

## L2 summary verification

The L2 reference checker compares the existing shadow-validation aggregate means within each tier and observation surface. For both Strong and Weak, the integer upper reference is **1** on the exact classifier-head surface and **1** on the 2048-dimensional full-update sketch.

The L2 reference checker is read-only, and the recorded 12 mean statistics are descriptive. **Separately**, the updated paper-protocol filtering dispatch now enforces per-client relative L2 budgets on the exact classifier-head update and original uncompressed full-model update, both with budget 1. For matched-contrast, PCA, random, head-only/full-basis ablations, and Complete ASLWF, the client filtering perturbation is uniformly rescaled before FedAvg **only if** either bound is exceeded. The Clip+Gaussian baseline retains its independent absolute-norm clipping and noise rule. The full-update L2 statistic in the spreadsheet is the 2,048-dimensional signed-hash proxy; it is **not** an exact full-model norm and cannot certify whether an old training run respected the new exact-space hard constraint. The new implementation affects prospective training, not already completed runs; historical table values require their original update-level evidence to establish that no additional clipping would occur.

Run:
`python -m src.acm_revision.l2_reference`

The 12 source rows and their measurement definitions are preserved in `docs/paper_repro/l2_summary_reference.csv`.

## One complete execution pipeline

Prerequisites: licensed Hateful Memes dataset, prepared strict split files, Python environment per \`requirements.txt\`, available GPUs for FL, and actual complete historical or regenerated shadow-only basis outputs.

1. Validate data partition feasibility: \`python -m src.acm_revision.core72_modality_first_plan validate --check-data\`.
2. Generate exactly 72 core configs:

   \`python -m src.acm_revision.paper_protocol_plan --stage core\`

   This writes \`configs/acm_revision/generated/paper_repro_20261017/core/jobs.tsv\` and individual YAMLs to an isolated output directory. The generated configs are the **only** scientific source for formal Core72 jobs. Run the 72 configurations with the strict existing FL runner (example below), and verify capture manifests, seed roles and 150-round completion. No generator directly trains the model.

3. Build the matched reference checkpoints and offline bases **only on shadow-train seed142**. The reference run must retain all eight checkpoint states. Use \`src.acm_revision.defense70_prepare write-reference-config\` for the reference, execute it under \`privacy_capture_runner_resume_v2\`, and then \`src.acm_revision.defense70_prepare fit\` with \`--reference-config\`, \`--reference-run-dir\`, \`--output-dir results/acm_revision/defense70_prep\`, \`--samples-per-branch 100\`. This locks \`locked_params.yaml\`. Confirm weak=(1,.25), strong=(5,1), 96 contrasts, 512-d basis projection and seed242 calibration.
4. Generate **70 matched-only and comparison** FL configs:

   \`python -m src.acm_revision.paper_protocol_plan --stage baselines\`

   This command **requires** the actual LOCKED \`locked_params.yaml\`. It uses the original frozen ranks, strengths and filtering directions.
5. Prepare the attacker-guided head basis from only shadow-training Core72 exact classifier-head updates (seeds142/143), validate on shadow-val242, and lock \`locked_headfix.yaml\`. The code: \`python -m src.acm_revision.headfix_prepare --core-root results/acm_revision/paper_repro_20261017/core\`. The chosen **rank** is read from \`locked_headfix.yaml\`, not the default search MAX_RANK=64.
6. Generate **8 complete ASLWF** FL configs:

   \`python -m src.acm_revision.paper_protocol_plan --stage complete\`

   It requires both LOCKED parameter manifests and preserves the complete ASLWF filtering configuration.
7. Run each job using:

   \`CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python -m src.acm_revision.privacy_capture_runner_resume_v2 --config PATH_TO_GENERATED_YAML --population shadow_train\`

   Replace config/population/GPU for each row of \`jobs.tsv\`. Each population/seed has its own output directory. No target data may enter basis, rank, or attack selection.
8. Produce **the one** common-shadow, defense-aware audit separately for No Defense, Matched-contrast Only and Complete ASLWF, providing each method's own consistent stored updates and an explicitly supplied `--baseline-task-csv`. Each audit uses shadow_train142, shadow_val242 and five independent targets, and unconditionally enforces 8 milestones/2048 full-update capture:

   \`python scripts/acm_revision/audit_headfix.py --root ACTUAL_RUN_ROOT --out ACTUAL_PAPER_AUDIT_DIR --baseline-task-csv ACTUAL_BASELINE_TASK_CSV\`

9. Compare Table 7 using all three real audit directories:

   \`python scripts/acm_revision/verify_paper_table7.py --no-defense NO_DEFENSE_AUDIT --matched-only MATCHED_AUDIT --complete-aslwf COMPLETE_AUDIT\`

   This comparison is strict; no pooled AUROC substitution, target-label orientation flip, or unverified historic table copy.
10. Verify the full source and locally available real results:

   \`python scripts/acm_revision/paper_repro_preflight.py --root . --strict-artifacts\`

This pipeline contains **no option to revert to 8192 dimensions, 10 capture rounds or change the reported eight-round observation protocol**. If a frozen historical result was generated using another protocol it must be flagged as a discrepancy rather than quietly reused.

## Reproducibility handover and important distinctions

- Matched-basis construction is different from attacker-guide head-basis construction. The latter uses both shadow train seeds 142/143; all non-head groups retain matched contrast directions.
- Original 72 core FL runs exclude the later defense experiments; 70 defense baseline jobs comprise 10 operating points x 7 run seeds; Complete ASLWF adds 8 independent training runs.
- New per-client relative L2 enforcement is applied to the filtering perturbation, not the raw client update itself. A positive activation count in any rerun means that run is not numerically interchangeable with an uncapped historical output.
- The common-shadow 54-candidate strongest attack and the target-side per-surface diagnostics are *different* reporting procedures, and neither proves a universal privacy guarantee. Table E2 residual image-pathway leakage remains relevant.
- Track every stage with immutable generated YAML, SHA256 of both locked manifests, basis files, client partition manifests, capture manifests, attack-score CSVs, selected configurations, per-seed task checkpoints and confidence intervals. See \`TRACEABILITY.csv\`.
- The uploaded PDF contains numerical results which **cannot be certified from source alone**. Submit all available traceable underlying records with the code where permitted.

## CI guarantees (and limits)

GitHub Actions \`paper-aslwf-repro-ci.yml\` checks source syntax, exact 72 Core72 configs, strict protocol constants, rounded integer L2 summary references. CI PASS demonstrates **software/contract consistency**, not independent Hateful Memes paper result reproduction.
